name: Yamaha Raptor 700cc
blurb: The sport quad. Fast, light and demanding - for riders who already know what they are doing.

durations.label: 30 minutes
durations.blurb: The lowest commitment. Enough to learn the controls and cross a few dune faces on the Yamaha Raptor 700.

durations.label: 1 hour
durations.blurb: The sweet spot for most riders. Time to settle into the Yamaha Raptor 700 and get a proper run at the red dunes.

durations.label: 2 hours
durations.blurb: A longer route with more varied terrain and photo stops, for riders already comfortable on the Yamaha Raptor 700.

durations.label: 3 hours
durations.blurb: A half-day session. Suits confident riders and groups pairing the ride with a camp stop.

durations.label: 4 hours
durations.blurb: The longest route we run on the Yamaha Raptor 700. For experienced riders who want maximum time in the dunes.
